title: NpcConfig
description: NPC behavior constants loaded from data/config/npc.yaml at startup.

wanderPauseTicksMin.description: Minimum ticks an NPC pauses between wander steps.

wanderPauseTicksMax.description: Maximum ticks an NPC pauses between wander steps.

wanderStepTicksMax.description: Maximum ticks an NPC spends on a single wander move.

interactionRange.description: Distance (blocks) within which a player can interact with an NPC.

updateRange.description: Distance (blocks) beyond which clients no longer receive NpcUpdate messages (~6 chunks).

spawnCheckIntervalTicks.description: Ticks between NPC spawn eligibility checks.

maxSpawnAttemptsPerTick.description: Maximum NPC spawn attempts evaluated per tick.

jumpVelocity.description: Initial vertical speed when an NPC jumps (blocks/s). Formula: sqrt(2 * |gravity| * h).
